customers_say: Customers find the smart lock to be of good quality and appreciate its appearance, describing it as beautiful and premium-looking. Moreover, the installation process receives positive feedback, with one customer noting seamless integration through the app. Additionally, they praise its functionality, with one mentioning flawless real-time alerts, and its ease of use, with one highlighting the convenient finger and password entry options. Customers value its security features, with one noting it provides keyless entry without compromising safety, and consider it worth the money spent.
